method: Model-annotated reference with verbatim evidence, not human-adjudicated ground truth. Original 100 preserved; 810 saved Claude rows plus 75 recovered Claude draft rows plus 15 newly read and annotated Codex rows. Offline completion; no extraction API calls.

sampling.method: Complete the original seeded random 1000-label DSLD-only pilot, stored in ascending numeric ID order. The added 900 are the remaining rows of that draw, not a fresh random draw. Original gold-100 was its lowest-ID prefix.

provenance.recovery: Recovered literal extraction data from build_19.py, build29.py and the first 15 rows in extract_a.py without executing their code. Recovered extracted_at timestamps use draft-file modification times. Existing saved timestamps preserved.
provenance.review_scope: Exact source, coverage, schema, confidence, evidence grounding and header audit for all rows; targeted convention checks on the added 900. Not a complete independent semantic reannotation.

provenance.grounded_field: Added grounded=true to all new evidence entries only after exact case-sensitive substring checks.

conventions.original_100: Unchanged prior annotations and prompt convention. Their evidence blocks and granularity can be broader than the expansion.
conventions.expansion_900: Use the frozen instructions, including general packaging exclusion, its explicit no-other-risk fallback, storage exclusion and child-safety fallback. Finer distinct-claim splitting retained from Claude.
conventions.adverse_event_contact: Pure reporting/contact lines excluded as administrative text; actual adverse effects and medical-response cautions retained.
conventions.limitations: Mixed annotators and prompt versions; claim granularity varies. Grounding verifies quotations, not completeness or semantic correctness. The set has not been independently human-adjudicated.

header_audit.method: Case-sensitive substring check in full passage and statement body after removing bracketed statement-type prefixes; separately check pre-LABEL STATEMENTS headers.
header_audit.interpretation: No retained evidence requires metadata headers. This does not prove that removing header context leaves model predictions unchanged.
